referenceMechanisms: Global instance list groups providers and exposes labels, dedicated directories, observed login state with observation time, and seat occupancy; new-and-login is one user action.
Product prepares an independent home; vendor CLI owns credentials. Product does not copy authentication between instances.
Codex reference uses normal codex login; CLI output supplies authorization URL. Real login explicitly enables host browser opening and UI offers a clickable authorization link.

Backend loginSessions map is indexed by instance/session key and home, retains progress, final exit code and normalized/masked output. login-status queries by instance; frontend request UUID is not required to find the current login.
Line sink decodes split UTF-8 chunks, removes ANSI, buffers complete lines, flushes final partial output and masks secrets before display.
Login process completion and actual login readiness are separate. Free vendor status command confirms readiness; UI displays progress and detection actions.
Running and bound instance protections live in the store; PID and creation time identify surviving prior processes; normal stop/failure/removal paths release appropriate occupancy.
referenceLimits: Login session map survives panel replacement within the same host process; it is not durable process-restart storage. Do not claim restart recovery from this reference.
Reference allows one seat per instance; Design37 explicitly supports multiple isolated sessions and configured concurrency4. Do not copy its one-seat restriction.

Reference includes host CLI reuse and loginEnv restores real AppData for browser profiles. Current gogoke test identity remains independent and LPAC confined; copying those environment values or adopting Owner home would require a separate boundary analysis.
Reference launches Edge/explorer and also uses window.open. It is an interaction reference, not authorization to operate an external authentication browser or assume foreground visibility.
Reference delete retries and source-comment claims are not automatically appropriate production fixes for gogoke.
